patch_description: Inspired by prior ShinkaEvolve tic-tac-toe ansatz seeds, this design keeps a symmetry-guided, parameter-efficient structure while enriching the entangling pattern without increasing the number of trainable parameters. The key change is a two-pass CRX ring entangler on the board perimeter (same shared angle) with ascending and descending edge orders, which diversifies the entanglement without adding new parameters. This is complemented by a center-to-edge hub entangler (CRY) and the same pre/post RZ/RY scaffolding as before. By reusing a single CRX parameter across two ring traversals, we increase circuit expressivity and potential performance while maintaining parameter efficiency. The overall parameter count per block remains the same (no extra learnable parameters were introduced), so parameter_efficiency remains interpretable while potentially improving validation/test metrics through richer entanglement patterns.
